name: Ohio

context: OH 340: Cover crop aims to reduce sheet, rill and wind erosion; aim for at least 90-percent combined canopy and residue cover during erosive wind or rain.
cover_rules: OH 340: Plant within the listed window, or up to 2 weeks after its last date if the seeding rate is increased by 20 percent.
OH 340: Time establishment so the soil is protected during the critical erosion periods. Do not mechanically harvest cover crop biomass.
residue: OH 329: No till keeps a minimum of 60 percent residue cover on the soil surface throughout the year.
OH 329: Do not shred residue after harvest; shredding makes it more susceptible to movement by wind or water.
barriers: OH 603: Barriers need minimum expected height 1.5 feet, porosity of 40 to 50 percent, spacing not over 10 times barrier height.

coverPlant.text: OH 340: Northern Ohio winter rye 7-15 to 11-1; oats 8-1 to 9-20; winter wheat 9-22 to 10-22.
OH 340: Southern Ohio winter rye 8-1 to 11-15; oats 8-1 to 9-30; winter wheat 9-30 to 11-1.
